sloka: सदा सुखम् अहम् मन्ये यम् पुरा सह सीताया ।मारुतः स विना सीताम् शोक संजनओ मम  ॥४-१-५४॥
transliteration: sadā sukham aham manye yam purā saha sītāyā ।mārutaḥ sa vinā sītām śoka saṁjanao mama  ॥4-1-54॥

translations.english: 'The crow that cried unhappily flying in the sky as if to foretell my separation from Sita, is now on the tree, singing joyfully (suggesting my possible union with Sita).
